note: Ana is going to the museum. Luis identifies the right bus. At the counter Ana asks for a ticket and its price; the clerk hands it over and she thanks the clerk. She boards the identified bus, hears the next stop, gets off, and completes the walk to the museum. Ticket, route number/color, destination and stop announcement must agree. All ticket words are introduced here before their service use. No inference of goes from an ordinary parked-bus photograph.
